title: cupressus lindleyi subsp. hondurensis
intro: Cupressus lindleyi subsp. hondurensis, commonly known as Honduran cypress, is a plant species belonging to the cypress family (Cupressaceae) that is native to Honduras. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can be used to treat various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Cupressus lindleyi subsp. hondurensis include its antioxidant, anti-diarrheal, and antiseptic properties, which can be used to treat digestive issues, wounds, and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include volatile oils, flavonoids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
